title: Universal Cross-app Attacks: Exploiting and Securing OAuth 2.0 in Integration Platforms
summary: Studies account linking across multi-app integration platforms and identifies inconsistent app identity as a trust-boundary problem. Proposes app-specific authorization-context binding.
defensive_use: Review whether an owned integration preserves the intended app and authorization issuer throughout account linking, including compatibility migrations.
